integrity.literature_boundary: The general positivity of products of commuting positive operators is prior theory; the claim is source-specific.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact two-dimensional matrix computation plus operator-order comparison under pairwise commutation.
integrity.unproved_limits: No classification of all weaker hypotheses ensuring comparability of the controlled and ordinary frame operators is asserted.

scientific_limitations: Pairwise commutation is proved sufficient for the repaired equivalence but is not claimed to be logically minimal.
The result corrects one named equivalence theorem and does not assess all other statements in the source.
An unindexed erratum, thesis remark, or informal correction may contain the same source-specific observation.
title: A two-dimensional noncommuting-controller obstruction to a controlled fusion-frame equivalence
